firstPlayerRule: For the cooperative base game, the player with the longest arms is the first Architect. The next player to the left is the Supervisor, followed by the Builder.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This assigns the opening team roles. The Architect starts the timer and gestures to the Supervisor while the three players work together.
In the competitive TEAM3VS3 variant, teams race simultaneously; there is no team that moves first.
